data.title: BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors
data.description:
BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors

New rules-based solution combines complementary investment strategies to help advisors provide disciplined Bitcoin exposure while managing volatility

BX Partners, a research-driven investment consulting platform serving chief investment officers (CIOs), financial advisors, registered investment advisers (RIAs), and broker-dealers, today announced the launch of the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model, a rules-based investment solution designed to help financial advisors incorporate Bitcoin into client portfolios through a disciplined, systematic investment process. Available through the BX Index platform, the model combines two independent investment methodologies from Dynalogic and phaseinvest to help advisors pursue Bitcoin's growth potential while seeking to reduce volatility and downside risk.

As interest in digital assets continues to grow, many financial advisors face a difficult challenge: how to address client demand for Bitcoin without exposing portfolios to the asset's historically significant volatility. Rather than relying on traditional buy-and-hold approaches or discretionary market timing, the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model applies two complementary, rules-based strategies that systematically respond to changing market conditions.

"The BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model solves a real problem advisors face every day," said Christopher McHeffey, co-founder of BX Partners. "Their clients are asking about Bitcoin, but there hasn't been a satisfying answer between 'just don't' and 'put it all in a spot ETF and hold on.' This model gives advisors a third option: structured, transparent, and built around managing risk rather than hoping it goes up."

"What makes this model different is that it's not trying to predict Bitcoin," added Craig Cmiel, director at BX Partners. "It's designed to respond to it systematically, without emotion. The Dynalogic component sells into strength and buys into weakness by design. The phaseinvest PDE layer catches regime shifts early. Together they do what most investors struggle to do on their own."

TWO INDEPENDENT STRATEGIES. ONE DISCIPLINED INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK.

The BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model combines two complementary methodologies that respond to different market signals.

The Dynalogic strategy uses the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). It follows a tiered, price-contingent process, taking profits as Bitcoin climbs and redeploying capital at larger sizes as it falls, embedding a natural sell-high, buy-low discipline without relying on human judgment.

"Advisors don't need a reason to be interested in Bitcoin," stated Bill Flowers, founder and managing director of Dynalogic. "Their clients are already asking. What they need is a framework they can stand behind in a client meeting, something they can explain, something with a clear process, and something that doesn't make them look reckless. That's exactly what the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model provides."

The phaseinvest Phase Detection Engine (PDE), developed originally for equities, identifies structural breaks in Bitcoin's volatility to determine the current market regime, then measures momentum only within that phase. When momentum is positive, the strategy holds maximum exposure. When it turns negative, it steps back and allocates to short-duration Treasuries until conditions improve.

"We built the PDE strategy because traditional momentum models have a fundamental flaw – they measure price across different market regimes, so they're always a step behind at exactly the wrong moment," said Arun Soni, CEO of phaseinvest. "By isolating momentum within its current regime, the PDE responds faster, protects capital more effectively in downturns, and gets back in sooner when conditions improve."

DESIGNED TO IMPROVE RISK-ADJUSTED OUTCOMES

In backtested results covering June 2021 through June 2026, the blended BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model generated a total return of 160.3%, compared with 89.3% for a traditional buy-and-hold Bitcoin strategy. During the same period, the model produced 35% lower annualized volatility while reducing maximum drawdown by 17 percentage points. All performance figures are hypothetical and based on back-tested results.

With the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model, advisors can bring a disciplined, transparent Bitcoin strategy to client conversations with a documented process, a clear risk management framework, and a track record they can point to. Access is available immediately at https://bxindex.com/bitcoin-model/. The BX Bitcoin strategy is also available on the UX Wealth platform.

ABOUT BX PARTNERS

BX Partners is a research-driven investment consulting platform that supports financial professionals in building institutional-quality models with the goal of enhancing existing internal asset management platforms. BX combines quantitative, rules-based, and AI-enabled methodologies to curate high-conviction strategies designed to outperform across market cycles. The BX team conducts rigorous due diligence on many strategies each year, selecting only the ones that have the strongest potential to deliver risk-adjusted returns. The company has so far selected 25 leading research firms and 65 strategies to be included in the platform. BX is not a money manager. BX operates as a strategy engine, research partner, and open architecture solution. The BX technology suite includes the BX Advisor App, BX Risk Shield, and BX Core, giving financial professionals real-time analytics, market insights, and financial planning tools. BX Partners delivers the power behind the industry’s most innovative investment departments. To learn more about BX Partners, visit www.BXIndex.com.

data.title: Access Vascular Receives Innovative Technology Contract from Vizient for HydroMID® Midline Catheter
data.description:
Access Vascular Receives Innovative Technology Contract from Vizient for HydroMID® Midline Catheter

Access Vascular, Inc. (AVI), a medical device company specializing in developing advanced vascular access solutions, today announced its HydroMID® midline catheter has received an Innovative Technology contract from Vizient®, the nation’s largest provider-driven healthcare performance improvement company. The contract was awarded based on review of the HydroMID® device from hospital experts who serve on one of Vizient’s client-led councils, and it signifies to Vizient clients its unique qualities that potentially bring improvement to the healthcare industry.

Innovative Technology contracts are awarded following a thorough evaluation of products submitted through Vizient’s Innovative Technology Program. Vizient client-led councils identify technologies that have the potential to enhance clinical care, patient safety, healthcare worker safety or improve business operations of healthcare organizations.

AVI’s HydroMID® catheters feature a proprietary hydrogel material to help address catheter-related complications such as thrombosis and occlusion – potential sources of morbidity, readmissions, and cost for health systems. The U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) cleared a new anti-thrombogenic indication for HydroMID® in 2025.1

“We’re excited to be awarded the Vizient Innovative Technology contract as it recognizes our clinical differentiation and potential to elevate the standard of care,” said James Biggins, Chief Executive Officer of Access Vascular. “The HydroMID® catheter has been shown to significantly reduce complication rates and is the only drug-free midline catheter indicated as anti-thrombogenic by the FDA. The Innovative Technology contract from Vizient provides us an opportunity to bring enhanced access of HydroMID® to Vizient clients, and the patients they serve.”

“Through the Vizient client-led council evaluation process, HydroMID® Midline Catheter demonstrated the potential to offer meaningful differentiation in today’s competitive landscape. After careful review, the council recommended an Innovative Technology contract to Access Vascular,” said Kelly Flaharty, associate vice president, contract operations for Vizient.

Vizient represents a diverse client base that includes academic medical centers, pediatric facilities, community hospitals, integrated health delivery networks and non-acute healthcare providers and has a portfolio that represents more than $156 billion in annual purchasing volume. Through its Innovative Technology Program, Vizient works with client-led councils and task forces to evaluate products for their potential to bring real innovation to healthcare. If it is determined that a product is innovative, Vizient may award a contract outside of the competitive bid cycle.

About Access Vascular

Access Vascular, Inc., based in Billerica, Massachusetts, is a medical device company specializing in developing and commercializing innovative vascular access solutions. The company’s hydrophilic MIMIX® technology is designed to combat thrombosis and infection – with the goal of improving patient outcomes and clinical workflows. For more information, visit www.accessvascularinc.com, or follow us on LinkedIn.

FDA 510(k) K243458 includes the HydroMID single-lumen catheter. The clinical impact has not been evaluated in human clinical trials. The device is not intended for the treatment of existing vein thrombosis.

Genesco Launches Wrangler Footwear Collection

--Fall 2026 Collection Brings Wrangler’s Iconic Heritage to Footwear--

--Adds New Growth Platform to Genesco Brands Group--

Genesco Inc. (NYSE: GCO) today announced the launch of its Wrangler® footwear collection, marking an important milestone in its multiyear licensing agreement with Kontoor Brands (NYSE: KTB) and its legendary denim and lifestyle brand.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260914296624/en/

Wrangler Mens Fargo Timber Bark and Wrangler Womens Myrtle Saddle Tan Ivory

The Fall 2026 collection brings Wrangler’s authentic Western style to men’s, women’s and children’s footwear across Western, work and casual lifestyle categories. The collection launches September 15 on Wrangler.com, with availability at select retailers across the United States rolling out later in the season. Retail prices range from $100 to $240.

“Wrangler represents a significant growth opportunity for Genesco Brands Group and reflects our strategy to build and scale leading lifestyle brands in footwear,” said Rick Higgins, president of Genesco Brands Group. “We’ve combined Wrangler’s iconic heritage and deep connection with consumers with our footwear expertise to create a collection that is unmistakably Wrangler.”

"Footwear is a natural extension of Wrangler’s authentic Western roots and rugged everyday style, allowing our consumers to embrace the brand from head to toe," said Steve Armus, Vice President of Licensing and Collaborations at Wrangler. “Genesco’s proven footwear expertise makes them the ideal partner to translate our authentic style into a comprehensive collection. By pairing our legacy of durability and craftsmanship with Genesco's industry-leading capabilities, we are delivering the superior quality, comfort, and timeless design consumers expect for daily wear."

The assortment features premium materials, including full-grain leather and authentic denim textiles, while select work styles meet ASTM standards for safety-toe protection and slip- and oil-resistant performance.

About Genesco Inc.
Genesco Inc. (NYSE: GCO) is a Footwear First company with distinctively positioned retail and lifestyle brands and proven omnichannel capabilities offering customers the footwear they desire in engaging shopping environments, including more than 1,180 retail stores and branded e-commerce websites. Its Journeys, Little Burgundy and Schuh brands serve teens, kids and young adults with on-trend fashion footwear that inspires youth culture in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. Johnston & Murphy serves successful, affluent men and women with premium footwear, apparel and accessories in the U.S. and Canada, and Genesco Brands Group sells branded lifestyle footwear to leading retailers under licensed brands including Wrangler, Dockers and Starter. Founded in 1924, Genesco is based in Nashville, Tennessee. For more information on Genesco and its operating divisions, please visit www.genesco.com.

Wrangler®, of Kontoor Brands (NYSE: KTB), has been an icon in authentic American style for 75 years. With a rich legacy rooted in the Western lifestyle, Wrangler is committed to offering superior quality and timeless design. Its collections for men, women, and children look and feel great, inspiring all those who wear them to be strong and ready for everyday life. Wrangler is available in retail stores worldwide, including flagship stores in Fort Worth and Greensboro, department stores, mass-market retailers, specialty shops, top western outfitters, and online. data.title: Grab to Buy Majority Stake in SoftBank-Backed Atome for About $1.5 Billion
data.description:
By Kimberley Kao 




  Grab has agreed to buy a 60% stake in Atome Financial for $1.49 billion in cash. 



  The transaction is expected to close by the third quarter of 2027, Grab said Tuesday. 



  Atome is a digital-finance platform that operates in Southeast Asia offering buy-now-pay-later, insurance and other services. It is part of Singapore-based Advance Intelligence Group, whose investors include SoftBank and Warburg Pincus. 



  Atome's use of artificial intelligence to assess borrowers and manage risk will "help to scale and strengthen Grab's whole ecosystem," Grab President and Chief Operating Officer Alex Hungate said. 



  Grab also agreed to buy the remaining 40% from Advance Intelligence Group and other shareholders about two years after the initial transaction closes. 



  Grab expects its financial-services segment to generate $500 million in adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization by 2028, with a combined loan portfolio of more than $6 billion. 



  It also raised its overall adjusted Ebitda target for 2028 to $1.7 billion from $1.5 billion. 



  Grab has increasingly turned to acquisitions to support its growth this year. It bought U.S.-based Stash Financial at an enterprise value of $425 million and agreed to buy Foodpanda's Taiwan operations from Delivery Hero for $600 million. 



  The Atome deal would "bring a large external consumer-credit franchise inside another integrated regional platform," Singapore-based research and advisory firm Momentum Works said. 



  Independent [buy-now-pay-later] providers filled a gap while ecommerce and multipurpose digital platforms developed their own financial services, the firm said, noting that gap is narrowing as the platforms expand.

data.title: Dr. Ronald M. Clearie Joins New Jersey Urology, an Affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners
data.description:
Dr. Ronald M. Clearie Joins New Jersey Urology, an Affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners

New Jersey Urology is pleased to announce that Dr. Ronald M. Clearie has joined the practice. Dr. Clearie provides comprehensive urologic care and will support patients with a wide range of urologic needs, reflecting New Jersey Urology’s commitment to accessible, high-quality care across the state.

New Jersey Urology spans more than 20 locations throughout the central and southern regions of the state and is a leading provider of urology and cancer care services, bringing the latest treatments and technologies to the community. New Jersey Urology is an affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners, a partner to community-based practices that is backed by General Atlantic.

Dr. Gordon A. Brown, New Jersey Urology, stated, “On behalf of New Jersey Urology, we are pleased to welcome Dr. Ronald Clearie to our team. His clinical training, patient-centered approach and commitment to high-quality urologic care will be a strong asset to our patients and communities. Dr. Clearie brings a thoughtful, collaborative mindset that aligns with our mission to deliver advanced care in the communities we serve.”

Dr. Ronald Clearie stated, “I am honored to join New Jersey Urology and be part of a team known for clinical excellence, collaboration and compassionate care. I was drawn to New Jersey Urology’s commitment to pairing advanced urologic care with a community-based approach that enables patients to receive care close to home. I look forward to building trusted relationships with patients and working with my colleagues to provide accessible, high-quality care throughout New Jersey.”

Dr. Clearie received his Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine from Rowan University School of Osteopathic Medicine. He also holds a Master of Biomedical Science from Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School’s Graduate School of Biomedical Science. He earned his Bachelor of Arts in Biological Sciences from Rutgers University’s School of Arts and Sciences, graduating cum laude with a focus in microbiology and anatomy.

In addition to his clinical training, Dr. Clearie has published and presented extensively on topics related to urological research, medicine and patient care. He is also committed to teaching and mentoring others, sharing knowledge to support the next generation of medical professionals. His dedication to service also extends beyond the clinical setting through community involvement and outreach.

“My patient care philosophy begins with listening carefully, communicating clearly and developing individualized treatment plans that reflect each patient’s goals and quality of life. I want patients to feel comfortable asking questions, understanding their options and taking an active role in their care. My goal is to provide evidence-based treatment and compassionate support so every patient feels heard, informed and confident,” Dr. Clearie said.

New Jersey Urology has more than 20 medical offices throughout the following counties: Atlantic, Bucks (PA), Burlington, Camden, Cumberland, Gloucester, Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth and Somerset.

To learn more about Dr. Clearie or schedule an appointment, visit www.njurology.com. Dr. Clearie will primarily serve patients at the Voorhees and Woodbury offices.

About U.S. Urology Partners

U.S. Urology Partners offers a comprehensive suite of practice management capabilities to its affiliated community-based urology practices, which maintain their local brand and identity that they have established, often over decades. U.S. Urology Partners currently supports six affiliated groups across a network of more than 70 locations in Florida, Indiana, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Ohio. For more information, visit www.us-uro.com.

data.title: SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation
data.description:
SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation

SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation

PR Newswire

LONDON, Sept. 15, 2026

LONDON, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SKE, a leading vape brand in the UK and Europe, brought its "Cool For The Summer" campaign to life at Appetite On The Farm 2026, serving as the festival's exclusive vape sponsor on August 29-30 at Kelvedon Hall in Essex, which welcomed more than 20,000 attendees.

Bringing SKE's Summer Spirit to the Festival

As the exclusive vape sponsor, SKE created a dedicated activation space inspired by the character of a British countryside farm. The open-plan timber structure and prominent SKE branding provided a distinctive focal point within the festival site, while its relaxed, welcoming design complemented the outdoor setting of Appetite On The Farm. Conveying the brand ethos of "Enjoy SKE, Enjoy Every Moment", the space quickly became a popular meeting point for festival-goers, with groups of friends stopping by to explore the brand, take photos and participate in activities. The combination of music, social interaction and the festival's outdoor atmosphere helped create a relaxed and energetic environment around the SKE activation.

Flavours, Prizes and Festival Experiences

Throughout the two-day event, SKE offered a programme of activities designed to encourage adult attendees to discover the brand in an informal festival environment.

Product Flavour Sampling: Attendees had the opportunity to explore SKE's flagship SKE BAR and SKE BAR 15K, with a selection of cooling iced, sweet-and-tangy and tropical fruit flavours available to sample.

The SKE BAR combines a familiar design and flavour range with a reusable pod-based format. It features a 500mAh rechargeable battery with Type-C charging and a replaceable pod system using durable, recyclable PCG material. The device is designed to provide consistent flavour throughout its use.

Alongside it, the SKE BAR 15K offered a higher-capacity option, featuring up to 15,000 puffs, an 850mAh battery, a visible top tank and dynamic lighting effects. Its larger format and distinctive design made it particularly suited to the outdoor festival environment.

Hourly Lucky Draws: Adding an element of surprise throughout the weekend, SKE hosted hourly lucky draws each day. Festival-goers had the chance to win exclusive prizes, with each draw creating another moment of excitement around the SKE activation.

One lucky attendee said:

"I came to the festival with friends simply to enjoy the music, so I was pleasantly surprised to receive an unexpected prize as well. The atmosphere at the SKE booth was full of energy, and I really enjoyed the experience. It made the whole festival feel even more special."

Connecting Through Music and Shared Experiences

The UK has always been an important part of SKE's journey, and Appetite On The Farm provided a valuable opportunity to connect directly with adult consumers in a vibrant and authentic festival environment. This activation marks the finale of SKE's Cool For The Summer' campaign, bringing together the energy of summer, music and shared experiences.

About SKE

SKE is a leading vaping brand in the UK and across Europe, renowned for its user experience, extensive flavour range and product innovation. The brand develops vaping products with a focus on product design, functionality and distinctive aesthetics, serving adult consumers across international markets. Through continued innovation and a user-focused approach, SKE aims to deliver convenient and personalised vaping experiences.

For more information, please visit SKE's official website at https://www.skevape.com, or connect with SKE on social media:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/skevapeofficial
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/skevapeofficial
X: https://x.com/skevapeofficial
For media inquiries, please contact media@skevape.com

data.title: ITRI Innovation Day Showcases 25 Cross-Domain Technologies and Advances Industry Collaboration
data.description:
ITRI Innovation Day Showcases 25 Cross-Domain Technologies and Advances Industry Collaboration

ITRI Innovation Day Showcases 25 Cross-Domain Technologies and Advances Industry Collaboration

PR Newswire

TAINAN, Sept. 15, 2026

TAINAN, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) hosted ITRI Innovation Day in Tainan, bringing together research organizations and startups to showcase 25 innovations across four areas: Global Innovation, Empowering Sustainability, Intelligent Future, and AI-Powered Unmanned Vehicles. The event highlighted how emerging technologies can translate R&D into industrial applications.

ITRI President Pei-Zen Chang said technology development will increasingly depend on the integration of software, hardware, and AI. "Innovation can no longer rely on a single technology. By integrating expertise across disciplines and strengthening connections among research organizations and industry, we can create greater value," he said. "With Taiwan's strengths in manufacturing and R&D, ITRI Innovation Day connects technology, talent, and industry needs in southern Taiwan to foster further innovation and industry opportunities."

Keynote speaker Frank Bonafilia, CEO of the Edison Awards, presented "What It Takes to Win: Unleashing the Edison Spirit to Build the Future Together." He introduced the Edison Awards' work in recognizing outstanding innovations worldwide and compared the approaches taken by the U.S. and Taiwan to commercializing innovation and financing startups, offering insights into turning research outcomes into market impact.

In the technology showcase, the Global Innovation area featured Edison Awards-winning technologies. Sustainable Pavement Material Recycling enables 100% reuse of reclaimed pavement materials, while the Prognosis Monitoring System achieves over 90% prediction accuracy for rotating machinery. The AI-Driven Smart Water Leak Detection System uses AI-powered acoustic analysis to rapidly detect and pinpoint water leaks, contributing to annual water savings of approximately 21.87 million cubic meters. Other highlights included LigamiX™: Hybrid Regenerative Ligament Technology, which transforms cost-effective textile materials into advanced medical applications, and NaPoGlass, which creates high-value applications from waste glass. The Metal Industries Research & Development Centre (MIRDC) also presented MagicABC, an AI-assisted language therapy solution that has helped improve language abilities in 81% of cases.

In Empowering Sustainability, the exhibition demonstrated how AI and advanced technologies support energy efficiency, smart manufacturing, agriculture, and aquaculture. The 3D Aluminum-Microchannel Thermosyphon Heat Sink addresses the cooling demands of high-power AI chips, while AI-Driven Precision Aquaculture Technology combines long-life dissolved oxygen sensing with AI-enabled automatic feeding. The Liquid-Borne Particle Counter for Wet Process Baths provides real-time monitoring of particle abnormalities during manufacturing, and Fruit Intelligent Grading Technology can reduce labor costs by 30% to 50%.

In Intelligent Future, we presented robotics technologies designed for industrial inspection, hazardous environments, and healthcare. The Intelligent Bionic Quadruped Robot operates in complex and high-risk environments, and the Formosa INSPECTOR—Smart Inspection Robot performs autonomous inspection tasks across multiple floors. The Livestock Guardian Robot integrates color imaging, night-vision thermal imaging, and AI recognition to conduct autonomous patrols. It monitors images, sounds, and locations in real time, enabling immediate detection and deterrence. In healthcare, UniCare Medbot helps reduce the burden of cleaning and disinfection for healthcare professionals, while MIRDC's SafeCare AI Collaborative Care Robot assists with patient repositioning and bedside care.

The AI-Powered Unmanned Vehicles showcase focused on autonomous flight, extended endurance, and intelligent sensing. The Low-Carbon Smart Fishing Fleet System triples fish-search efficiency, and ITRI ResilSwarm maintains stable data transmission over distances exceeding nine kilometers. For missions requiring greater endurance or payload capacity, the Long Endurance Fuel Cell Drone can carry a five-kilogram payload and remain airborne for three hours, while Drone Total Solutions With High-Payload and Long-Duration supports payloads of up to 50 kilograms. The showcase also featured technologies for sensing and navigation. The Edge AI Multi-Sensor Payload Module for Drones, which enhances all-weather target detection and tracking. The Inertial Sensor Fusion Autonomous Navigation Solution for GNSS-Denied Environments enables autonomous navigation when Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are disrupted or unavailable.

Beyond showcasing technologies, ITRI Innovation Day put collaboration into practice through on-site technology consultations and business matchmaking, enabling companies to engage directly with ITRI research teams. By leveraging the resources of three major industry associations in southern Taiwan, the event aimed to better match R&D results with industry needs and foster new partnerships.

About ITRI

The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) is a world-leading R&D organization dedicated to innovating a better future. Founded in 1973, ITRI has played a vital role in transforming Taiwan's industries from labor-intensive into innovation-driven. Over the years, ITRI has incubated hundreds of startups and spinoffs, including well-known companies such as UMC and TSMC. Headquartered in Taiwan, ITRI also operates offices in the U.S., Germany, the UK, Japan, and Thailand. For more information, please visit https://www.itri.org/eng.

data.title: Children's Health Dallas Earns National Recognition Across All Pediatric Specialties in U.S. News & World Report "Best Children's Hospitals" Rankings
data.description:
Children's Health Dallas Earns National Recognition Across All Pediatric Specialties in U.S. News & World Report "Best Children's Hospitals" Rankings

Children's Health Dallas Earns National Recognition Across All Pediatric Specialties in U.S. News & World Report "Best Children's Hospitals" Rankings

PR Newswire

DALLAS, Sept. 15, 2026

This is the ninth consecutive year of recognition across all 11 specialties; only children's hospital in the region to earn the distinction

DALLAS, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Children's Health℠, the leading pediatric health care system in North Texas, has once again been recognized among the nation's best pediatric hospitals in the U.S. News & World Report 2026-2027 "Best Children's Hospitals" rankings, earning recognition across all 11 pediatric specialties. It remains the only children's hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth and the surrounding region recognized in every pediatric specialty.

This marks the ninth consecutive year and the 15th time since 2008 that Children's Health Dallas has earned recognition across every pediatric specialty, reflecting the depth of expertise and specialized care available to children and families across the health system.

"This recognition is a testament to the extraordinary skill and commitment of our Children's Health team members and our academic partners at UT Southwestern Medical Center," said Christopher J. Durovich, President and Chief Executive Officer of Children's Health. "It reflects our shared commitment to ensuring children and families have access to exceptional, highly specialized care. Together, we remain focused on our mission to make life better for children and meeting the evolving health care needs in North Texas and beyond."

The U.S. News & World Report "Best Children's Hospitals" rankings provide a national assessment of the top pediatric hospitals that provide innovative treatments, exceptional safety measures and incredible outcomes. The rankings also consider national reputation, based on surveys of pediatric specialists who identify the hospitals they believe are best equipped to care for children with the most serious and complex conditions.

"Through our collaboration with Children's Health, we bring the strengths of academic medicine — clinical expertise, scientific discovery, and education — to advancing pediatric care," said Daniel K. Podolsky, M.D., President of UT Southwestern Medical Center. "This recognition reflects the expertise and dedication of our physicians and advanced practice providers and the teams they work with to provide compassionate, high-quality care to patients and families."

The 11 pediatric specialties and Children's Health Dallas' national rankings in each area are as follows:

  • Orthopedics*: No. 1
  • Cardiology & Heart Surgery: No. 5
  • Urology: No. 10
  • Neonatology: No. 15
  • Cancer: No. 17
  • Neurology & Neurosurgery: No. 17
  • Gastroenterology & GI Surgery: No. 20
  • Pulmonology & Lung Surgery: No. 22
  • Nephrology: No. 26
  • Diabetes & Endocrinology: No. 35
  • Behavioral Health**

*U.S. News includes Scottish Rite for Children in its evaluation of the performance of Children's Health Dallas for Pediatric Orthopedics. 
**The nation's top 50 Pediatric and Adolescent Behavioral Health programs did not receive a numerical ranking.

Children's Health Dallas U.S. News & World Report Highlights

  • Recognized in all 11 pediatric specialties for the ninth consecutive year – the only children's hospital in the region to achieve this distinction
  • Ranked #2 in Texas  
  • Honored for the 15th time since 2008 as one of the nation's top pediatric hospitals across all specialties 
  • Achieved three specialties ranked in the top ten and rank improvements in four pediatric specialties

*Region defined as Dallas-Fort Worth and its surrounding communities 

About Children's Health 
Children's Health is the leading pediatric health care system in North Texas and has long been recognized as a leader in pediatric health. Its campuses include Children's Medical Center Dallas, Children's Medical Center Plano and multiple Children's Health Specialty Centers, caring for more than 370,000 patients each year. With more than 11,000 team members and nearly 2,000 medical and dental staff, Children's Health provides more than $682 million in annual community benefit across North Texas.

In partnership with UT Southwestern Medical Center, it is consistently recognized among the nation's best pediatric hospitals by U.S. News & World Report. This commitment to excellence and outstanding care has resulted in recognition across all pediatric specialties for nine consecutive years, including Behavioral Health, Cancer, Cardiology & Heart Surgery, Diabetes & Endocrinology, Gastroenterology & GI Surgery, Neonatology, Nephrology, Neurology & Neurosurgery, Orthopedics, Pulmonology, and Urology.

Since 2009, Children's Health has maintained Magnet® designation – the highest honor for nursing excellence – and continues to earn employer-of-choice recognition locally, nationally and globally. These honors include the Great Place to Work® Certification™, the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award and Top Workplaces recognition from USA TODAY and The Dallas Morning News. Children's Health has also been named one of the 150 Best Places to Work in Healthcare by Becker's Hospital Review for 14 consecutive years.

For more information and to support Children's Health, visit childrens.com or like us on Facebook, follow Children's Health on X, Instagram and LinkedIn, and subscribe to our YouTube channel.

About U.S. News & World Report ranking methodology
To create the pediatric rankings, U.S. News & World Report gathers key clinical data from nearly 200 children's hospitals through a detailed survey that evaluates measures such as patient safety and quality outcomes, infection prevention and adequacy of nurse staffing. Part of each hospital's score is also derived from surveying pediatric specialists regarding where they would send the sickest children in their specialty. RTI International, an independent research and consulting firm, then analyzes the data and ranks the top 50 children's hospitals in each of the 11 pediatric specialty areas. In 2026-2027, 90 children's hospitals were ranked in at least one of the 11 pediatric specialties evaluated by U.S. News & World Report.

data.title: North American Morning Briefing: Stock Futures Fall, 10-Year Treasury Yield Surges
data.description:
Stock futures were down Tuesday as focus turned to the Federal Reserve's

interest rate decision on Wednesday.

Investors now see a 92% chance that officials hike rates by a quarter-percentage point, according to CME data, up from 59% a week ago.

"For market participants, the immediate challenge lies in navigating Wednesday's Fed decision, where the market is heavily positioned for a hike but remains vulnerable to a hawkish forward guidance stance," Tickmill Group said.

Oil prices continued to rise as traders assessed the impact of lost Saudi Arabian volumes after the attack on the country's East-West pipeline. Brent crude futures were up nearly 2% this morning to trade just below $108 a barrel.

Meanwhile, the selloff in global bonds gained traction on Tuesday, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since 2007 after it rose above 5% for the first time in almost three years on Monday.

"Rates markets remain hostage to oil and geopolitics ahead of Wednesday's Federal Open Market Committee [meeting]," Mizuho said.

Stocks to watch

Coinbase Global, Robinhood Markets, Strategy: Shares of companies tied to cryptocurrencies slid premarket alongside the price of bitcoin. The cryptocurrency recently traded around $76,800, down nearly 3% from its 4 p.m. ET price Monday.

Dave & Buster's Entertainment: The arcade chain swung to a loss in the most recent quarter as it struggles to regain relevancy with customers. Shares tumbled nearly 14% premarket.

Halliburton, Occidental Petroleum, Marathon Petroleum: Shares of energy companies advanced premarket as Brent crude oil prices jumped to nearly $108 a barrel.

Watch For:

U.S. Empire State Manufacturing Survey for September; FOMC meeting; Canada Wholesale Inventories for July

Today's Top Headlines/Must Reads:

- Warsh's Arrival Ended Trump's War With the Fed. A Rate Hike Would Test the Truce.

- Bond Yields Could Come Down as Fast as They've Climbed

- The Stagnant Housing Market Is About to Face a 7% Mortgage

MARKET WRAPS Forex:

The dollar rose as investors anticipated the Fed will increase interest rates amid elevated oil prices as the Middle East conflict worsens and strong inflation and jobs data.

The euro fell. The currency could fall against the dollar if the Fed raises interest rates on Wednesday and signals the prospect of further tightening, ING said.

Sterling fell after data showed continued signs of softness in the U.K. labor market ahead of Thursday's Bank of England interest-rate decision.

Bonds:

Treasury yields rose across maturities in Asian trade after the 10-year yield rose above 5% for the first time since October 2023 on Monday.

Energy:

Brent rose 1.75% while WTI was up 1.8%. Prices remained below Monday's intraday highs.

Metals:

Gold futures were down 0.5% at $4,331.20 a troy ounce in morning European trade. The fall comes as higher energy prices reinforce expectations that the Fed will begin raising rates, ANZ said.

Iron ore

Iron ore futures were lower in Asian trade. Demand for iron ore remains weak in China, while supplies are still high, Baocheng Futures said.

TODAY'S TOP HEADLINES

AXA Targets More Growth With New Targets

AXA said earnings should keep growing over the next few years as the French insurer intends to gain market share after years of reorganization.

The new growth plan, which includes targets for 2027-29, builds on the repositioning the company has carried out in recent years to create a simpler organization, it said Tuesday.

OpenAI Buys Startup Developing Smartphone Camera

OpenAI quietly bought a startup developing higher quality cameras for smartphones in recent months, according to people familiar with the matter.

The company, Glass Imaging, is developing technology that uses artificial intelligence to produce image quality on par with a DSLR camera.

Abbott Agrees to $385 Million Settlement in Baby Formula Case

Abbott Laboratories has agreed to pay $385 million to settle allegations related to its management of a baby formula facility where deadly bacteria was suspected of causing infant deaths, the Justice Department said Monday.

The settlement is a more lenient outcome than some prosecutors had advocated for, believing they had evidence to criminally charge Abbott under a law that has been used to pursue other businesses for selling contaminated foods, the Journal previously reported. But senior Justice Department officials believed criminal charges would have been heavy handed and closed the probe.

Microsoft Sets Limits for AI Models as Altman Details Control Risks

Microsoft has published a provisional code of conduct that it aims to apply when training new artificial-intelligence models, the latest company to discuss limits on advanced AI systems as OpenAI's chief executive warned companies risk losing control of their AI systems.

Mustafa Suleyman, the CEO of Microsoft AI, told CNBC Monday that the company had been working for months on the new guidance, which includes principles it describes as "humanist AI," but chose to publish it now given the current debate around AI.

U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Rises to Highest Since 2007

The selloff in global bonds gained traction on Tuesday, pushing the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield to its highest level since 2007 after it rose above 5% for the first time in almost three years on Monday.

Investors accelerated selling of other global bonds too, pushing yields on 10-year German and Japanese government bonds to multiyear highs.

Oil Prices Rise as Middle East Supply Concerns Persist

Oil prices rose in early European trading Tuesday as the shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline and recent territorial gains by Houthi militants in Yemen kept concerns over Middle East crude supplies elevated.

Brent crude futures rose 1.8% to $107.59 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate gained 1.9% to $103.30 a barrel. Prices remained below Monday's intraday highs, when Brent briefly reached $109.80 a barrel and WTI touched $104.35 before paring gains. Brent ultimately settled at $105.68, while WTI settled at $101.39

German Investor Confidence Continues Improving Streak

German investor sentiment improved for a fifth-straight month in September, helped by continued resilience in the economy despite still-surging energy prices due to the conflict in the Middle East.

The ZEW Indicator of Economic Sentiment for Germany-which tracks the expectations of 196 analysts and investors at banks, insurance companies and other businesses-rose 0.5 point to 34.7 in September. That was, however, weaker than expectations from economists polled by The Wall Street Journal of an increase to 40.0.

The Lightning Offensive That Saw the Houthis Grab a Crucial Oil Corridor

DUBAI-After sitting out months of the Iran war, Yemen's Tehran-backed Houthi rebels seized a crucial maritime chokepoint in a lightning offensive over the weekend that further imperiled global energy supplies and injected the group into any effort to resolve the conflict.

It is an unusually prominent position for the group's warlord leader, Abdulmalik Al-Houthi, who claims descent from the Prophet Muhammad and rules his impoverished territory through fear and religious fervor. But it is one that reflects both the growing ambition of his 350,000-strong militant army and its prowess with military tactics, missiles and drones.

Supreme Court Blocks Trump's New Mail Ballot Requirements for Midterms

WASHINGTON-The Supreme Court on Monday blocked the Trump administration from imposing new requirements for mail ballots, averting what state and local officials warned would have been a crisis in the midterm elections.

In an unsigned one-paragraph ruling, over the dissent of two conservative justices, the court said the U.S. Postal Service can't enforce new rules that would have compelled states to quickly redesign their ballot envelopes, submit lists of voters to the federal government and get signoff from postal officials before ballots could be mailed to voters.

The Gulf's AI Nightmare Came Courtesy of an Iranian Drone

DUBAI-The day after the U.S. and Israel launched their opening strikes on Iran, the Islamic Republic shot back with swarms of drones aimed at the Gulf's newest high-value targets: American data centers.

More than six months after the barrage, a damaged Amazon Web Services facility in Abu Dhabi and another one in Bahrain are still mostly offline. The company has told clients to move their data to other regions while it repairs the sites and hasn't given a date for completing the work.

Oil Executives Say the Great Fuel Crisis Is Here

American oil executives warned for months that the prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz was bound to cause a fuel crisis. Now, they say it is here.

Commercial fuel stocks around the world have been depleting for more than six months, and strategic crude reserves can't be tapped much further. Attacks last week shut down a crucial crude pipeline in Saudi Arabia that bypassed the Strait, stranding at least 2.5 million barrels a day from an already tight global oil market, analysts estimate.
